expected.title: Digest job reads activity for all tenants outside withTenant and relies on an in-memory filter
expected.rationale: Cross-tenant read with bypass available: SEC-DB-02. The in-memory filter is not a control; one missed field leaks another tenant.

notes: The reviewer may add an S2 RUB-PERF-02 for the unbounded select; it is not required and does not count against agreement.
